description: Figure 4 is a bar chart that illustrates the proportion of incorrectly answered samples where Pop_GT is less than Pop_Ge, and the proportion of correctly answered samples where Pop_GT is greater than Pop_Ge. The chart has three sets of bars, each representing a different category: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The bars are color-coded to represent different models: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). In the Movies category, the blue bar (Llama3) is the tallest, followed by the red bar (Qwen2), and the yellow bar (ChatGPT) is the shortest. In the Songs category, the red bar (Qwen2) is the tallest, followed by the blue bar (Llama3), and the yellow bar (ChatGPT) is the shortest. In the Basketball category, the yellow bar (ChatGPT) is the tallest, followed by the blue bar (Llama3), and the red bar (Qwen2) is the shortest. The chart is used to compare the performance of the models in correctly and incorrectly answering questions related to the categories.
